amendment4.geometry_correction: Prelaunch inspection rejected legacy gdn-8m: it wraps fla.DeltaNet and silently ignores allow_neg_eigval. Approved replacement is actual FLAGatedDeltaNetLayer/fla.GatedDeltaNet, expansion8.625 chosen by instantiated parameter counts at dim256/depth4; wrapper default2 heads, key128, value1104. No legacy-gdn training performed. E97 retains approved H32/N32/expansion1. Parameter matching is not state-size matching or a one-factor mechanism ablation.
amendment4.recipe: Prior scratch8M suite: AdamWScheduleFree betas(.9,.95), wd.01, clip1, bf16 autocast/fp32 parameters, batch32, no warmup; every evaluation and checkpoint uses ScheduleFree eval/x-mode, training resumes y-mode; all trainable tied task-sized heads; no pretrained weights or optimizer state loaded
amendment4.instrument_difference: Dedicated trainable3721-class scratch vocab vs full pretrained vocab in X2 1.3B fine-tunes. Separate experiment classes, not directly numerically comparable; 1/p^2 remains reference. Small-prime diagnostics use p^2 vocab with unchanged backbone geometry.
amendment4.plateau: Eligibility>=10000; every250 boundaries; over trailing2000 best-val gain<0.001 (0.1pp) AND first250/final250 relative train-loss mean improvement<0.001 (0.1%); hard cap60000. Strict thresholds; no change to archived X2 stops.
amendment4.calibration_rationale: X2c E97 loss-window movement0.1491% at2e-4 and0.0757% at1e-3; GDN2 0.1189% and0.3210%. Prior1% threshold called all stagnant despite negative OLS slopes; calibrated0.1% resolves movement of this order. X2b terminal windows retained above. Task-observed calibration on released fine-tunes is disclosed, not an assertion of scratch convergence.
amendment4.data: Fresh procedural batch/update, seed-paired training streams across architectures/LRs; frozen128 archived train(unused)/512val/512test1x/512test4x/512test8x; p61 exact X2 input and NPZ hashes. One-step has only test1x; difficulty seed0 allLRs.
amendment4.selection: Per run maximum validation exact-state accuracy, lower validation CE, earlier update. Per architecture LR chosen by mean three-seed best validation accuracy, lower mean valCE, then smaller LR. No test-based LR/step/seed selection. Full matched-LR grid and best-LR views share the same data.
amendment4.fairness_verbatim: the grid is symmetric across architectures; any statement about an architecture's performance cites its best grid point AND the matched-lr reading.
amendment4.capacity: Every1000 plus best-val chain and stop; if free<400GiB prune to step0/current/current best/every10000, retaining checkpoint identities/hashes in ledger; never fabricate pruned cells. Fail closed below8GiB. Three co-tenants/card under exclusive leases, no preemption.
amendment4.resilience_requirements: Not applicable: standalone local lambda01 single-GPU training runs, no DiLoCo behavior, Frontier, Slurm, or WorksGood service used.
